message.content:
Based on my detailed analysis of the Arabic/English Sick Leave Report (تقرير إجازة مرضية) image, here is the complete technical specification for recreating this document in HTML/CSS:

## 1. OVERALL PAGE SPECIFICATIONS

**Dimensions & Layout:**
- **Aspect Ratio:** A4 (210mm × 297mm) or US Letter (8.5" × 11")
- **Background Color:** `#FFFFFF` (Pure White)
- **Margins:** 
  - Top: ~40px
  - Bottom: ~40px
  - Left/Right: ~30px
- **Page Padding:** Internal content area approximately 95% of page width

---

## 2. HEADER SECTION (Top Area)

**Layout:** Three-column flex layout with center alignment

### A. Seha Logo (Left)
- **Position:** X: 40px, Y: 35px from top-left
- **Dimensions:** Width: ~120px, Height: ~60px
- **Elements:**
  - Arabic text "صحة" (Seha): Font size ~24px, Bold, Color `#1a3a5c` (Dark Navy)
  - English text "Seha": Font size ~18px, Regular, Color `#333333`
  - Icon: Blue geometric "V" shape made of horizontal lines (4-5 lines), Color `#2e7dce` (Bright Blue), positioned to the right of text
- **Styling:** Vertical divider line (1px solid `#e0e0e0`) separating logo from center content, height: ~50px

### B. Kingdom Emblem (Center)
- **Position:** Centered horizontally, Y: 35px
- **Arabic Text:** "المملكة العربية السعودية" 
  - Font: Traditional Arabic/Thuluth style (or serif fallback)
  - Size: ~22px
  - Color: `#000000` or very dark gray `#1a1a1a`
- **English Text:** "Kingdom of Saudi Arabia"
  - Font: Serif (Times New Roman or Georgia)
  - Size: ~16px
  - Color: `#333333`
  - Position: Directly below Arabic text, centered
  - Line spacing: ~6px between Arabic and English

### C. Geometric Islamic Pattern (Right)
- **Position:** X: Right margin -150px, Y: 30px
- **Dimensions:** Width: ~140px, Height: ~80px
- **Style:** Wireframe geometric pattern (Islamic star/polygonal design)
- **Color:** Very light blue-gray `#b8c9db` or `#c5d5e5`
- **Opacity:** ~0.6 (subtle background element)
- **Lines:** Thin (~1px), interconnected triangular/geometric shapes forming abstract network pattern

---

## 3. TITLE SECTION

**Position:** Y: ~130px from top (approximately 90px below header baseline)

### Arabic Title: "تقرير إجازة مرضية"
- **Font Family:** Cairo, Tajawal, or Arial (sans-serif)
- **Font Size:** **28px** (Large, prominent)
- **Font Weight:** 600 (Semi-bold)
- **Color:** `#1565c0` (Material Blue 800) or `#1976d2` (Primary Blue)
- **Text Alignment:** Center
- **Letter Spacing:** Normal (Arabic)

### English Title: "Sick Leave Report"
- **Font Family:** Arial, Helvetica, or Roboto (sans-serif)
- **Font Size:** **20px**
- **Font Weight:** 500 (Medium)
- **Color:** `#37474f` (Blue Gray 800) or `#455a64`
- **Text Alignment:** Center
- **Position:** Immediately below Arabic title
- **Line Spacing:** **8px** gap between Arabic and English titles

**Total Title Block Height:** ~70px including spacing

---

## 4. TABLE SECTION (CRITICAL)

**Table Container:**
- **Start Y Position:** ~220px from top (or ~50px below titles)
- **X Position:** Centered (margin: 0 auto), left/right padding ~20px
- **Total Table Width:** **~950px** (on A4/Letter) or **~95%** of container width
- **Border Radius:** **8px** (rounded corners on outer border only)
- **Outer Border:** 1px solid `#cfd8dc` (Blue Gray 200)
- **Cell Border:** 1px solid `#eceff1` (Blue Gray 50) or `#e0e0e0`

### Column Structure (4 Columns):
| Column | Width % | Content | Alignment |
|--------|---------|---------|-----------|
| Col 1 | **18%** | Arabic Labels | Right-aligned |
| Col 2 | **32%** | English Values | Center/Left |
| Col 3 | **32%** | Arabic Values | Center/Right |
| Col 4 | **18%** | English Labels | Left-aligned |

*Note: The table uses a mirrored layout for RTL support but maintains this visual structure*

### ROW-BY-ROW SPECIFICATIONS:

#### Row 1: Leave ID / رقم الإجازة
- **Height:** **44px**
- **Background:** `#FFFFFF` (White)
- **Label (Col 4):** "Leave ID" - Font: 14px, Color: `#1565c0`, Font-weight: 600, Left-align
- **Value EN (Col 2):** "PSL25091906180" - Font: 13px, Color: `#333333`, Center
- **Value AR (Col 3):** Empty or same as EN in this case
- **Label AR (Col 1):** "رقم الإجازة" - Font: 14px, Color: `#1565c0`, Font-weight: 600, Right-align
- **Border-bottom:** 1px solid `#e0e0e0`

#### Row 2: Leave Duration / مدة الإجازة ⭐ SPECIAL ROW
- **Height:** **48px** (slightly taller)
- **Background:** **`#1a237e`** (Indigo 900) or **`#283593`** (Indigo 800) - **DARK NAVY BLUE**
- **Text Color (All cells):** **`#FFFFFF`** (White)
- **Label (Col 4):** "Leave Duration" - Font: 14px, Bold, White
- **Value EN (Col 2):** "1 day ( 19-09-2025 to 19-09-2025 )" - Font: 13px, White, Center
- **Value AR (Col 3):** "1 يوم (27-03-1447 إلى 27-03-1447 )" - Font: 13px, White, Center
- **Label AR (Col 1):** "مدة الإجازة" - Font: 14px, Bold, White, Right-align
- **Special:** This row spans full width with dark background, high contrast

#### Row 3: Admission Date / تاريخ الدخول
- **Height:** **42px**
- **Background:** `#FFFFFF`
- **Label:** "Admission Date" / "تاريخ الدخول" - Color: `#1565c0`
- **Values:** "19-09-2025" / "27-03-1447" - Color: `#333333`

#### Row 4: Discharge Date / تاريخ الخروج
- **Height:** **42px**
- **Background:** `#F5F7FA` (Very light blue-gray, alternating row color) or `#fafafa`
- **Label:** "Discharge Date" / "تاريخ الخروج" - Color: `#1565c0`
- **Values:** "19-09-2025" / "27-03-1447"

#### Row 5: Issue Date / تاريخ إصدار التقرير
- **Height:** **42px**
- **Background:** `#FFFFFF`
- **Label:** "Issue Date" / "تاريخ إصدار التقرير" - Color: `#1565c0`
- **Values:** "19-09-2025" / "19-09-2025"

#### Row 6: Name / الاسم
- **Height:** **46px** (slightly taller for name length)
- **Background:** `#F5F7FA` (Alternating)
- **Label:** "Name" / "الاسم" - Color: `#1565c0`
- **Value EN:** "AMANI AHAM A AL SAADI" - Font: 13px, Color: `#222`
- **Value AR:** "اماني احمد ع السعدي" - Font: 14px, Color: `#222`

#### Row 7: National ID / Iqama / رقم الهوية / الإقامة
- **Height:** **42px**
- **Background:** `#FFFFFF`
- **Label:** "National ID / Iqama" / "رقم الهوية / الإقامة" - Color: `#1565c0`
- **Value:** "11070746333" - Monospace font appearance, Color: `#333`

#### Row 8: Nationality / الجنسية
- **Height:** **42px**
- **Background:** `#F5F7FA`
- **Label:** "Nationality" / "الجنسية" - Color: `#1565c0`
- **Values:** "Saudi Arabia" / "السعودية"

#### Row 9: Employer / جهة العمل
- **Height:** **42px**
- **Background:** `#FFFFFF`
- **Label:** "Employer" / "جهة العمل" - Color: `#1565c0`
- **Values:** [Empty/Missing] / "منازل" (or empty in image)

#### Row 10: Practitioner Name / اسم الممارس
- **Height:** **52px** (taller for two-line name)
- **Background:** `#F5F7FA`
- **Label:** "Practitioner Name" / "اسم الممارس" - Color: `#1565c0`
- **Value EN:** "WALID ABDELHAMID ALI ABDELHAMID" - Two lines if needed, Font: 12.5px
- **Value AR:** "و lids عبد الحميد على عبد الحميد" - Font: 13px

#### Row 11: Position / المسمى الوظيفي
- **Height:** **42px**
- **Background:** `#FFFFFF`
- **Label:** "Position" / "المسمى الوظيفي" - Color: `#1565c0`
- **Values:** "General" / "طبيب عام"

### Table Typography Summary:
- **Labels (Headers):** Font-size: **14px**, Weight: **600**, Color: **`#1565c0`** (Blue), Font-family: Sans-serif
- **Values (Data):** Font-size: **13-13.5px**, Weight: **400**, Color: **`#212121`** (Dark Gray), Font-family: Sans-serif
- **Row Padding:** Vertical: **12px**, Horizontal: **16px**
- **Border-collapse:** Collapse (shared borders between cells)
- **Last Row Bottom Border:** Rounded bottom corners (border-radius: 0 0 8px 8px on table container)

---

## 5. FOOTER SECTION

**Start Y Position:** ~720px (immediately below table with ~30px gap)

### Layout: Two-column with vertical divider

#### LEFT COLUMN (Width: 48%):

**QR Code:**
- **Position:** X: 180px (centered in left column), Y: 730px
- **Size:** **80px × 80px** (square)
- **Style:** Standard QR code, black modules on white background
- **Border:** None (clean edges)

**Verification Text (Arabic):**
- **Position:** Below QR code, Y: 820px
- **Text:** "لتحقق من بيانات التقرير برجاء الدخول على موقع صحة من خلال الرابط موضح صوره"
- **Font Size:** **11px** or **12px**
- **Color:** `#333333`
- **Alignment:** Center (under QR code)
- **Max Width:** ~350px, line-height: 1.5

**Verification Text (English):**
- **Position:** Below Arabic verification text, Y: 850px
- **Text:** "To check the report please visit Seha's offical website"
- **Font Size:** **10.5px** or **11px**
- **Color:** `#555555` (Lighter than Arabic)
- **Alignment:** Center

**Link:**
- **Position:** Below English text, Y: 875px
- **Text:** "www.seha.sa/#/inquiries/slenquiry"
- **Font Size:** **11px**
- **Color:** **`#1565c0`** (Blue, underlined/hoverable style)
- **Decoration:** Underline

**Date/Time Block (Bottom Left):**
- **Time:** "2:36 AM"
  - Position: X: 40px, Y: 920px
  - Font: 12px, Bold, Color: `#000`
- **Date:** "Saturday, 20 September 2025"
  - Position: X: 40px, Y: 940px
  - Font: 12px, Regular, Color: `#333`

#### RIGHT COLUMN (Width: 48%):

**Hospital Logo:**
- **Position:** X: Right-center (around 700px), Y: 730px
- **Size:** Width: **100px**, Height: **80px**
- **Style:** Circular/stylized medical logo (appears to be a crescent or abstract medical symbol in blue)
- **Color:** Blue tones (`#3f51b5` to `#7986cb`)
- **Background:** White with subtle shadow or clean

**Hospital Name (Arabic):**
- **Position:** Below logo, Y: 820px
- **Text:** "مجموعة البحر الأحمر للرعاية الصحية"
- **Font Size:** **14px**
- **Font Weight:** **600** (Bold)
- **Color:** `#1a237e` (Dark Blue)
- **Alignment:** Center

**Hospital Name (English):**
- **Position:** Below Arabic name, Y: 842px
- **Text:** "red sea general medical group"
- **Font Size:** **12px**
- **Font Weight:** **500**
- **Color:** `#333333`
- **Style:** lowercase or small caps appearance

**License Number:**
- **Position:** Below English name, Y: 862px
- **Text:** "رقم الترخيص : 4810701201210007"
- **Font Size:** **11px**
- **Color:** `#000000` (Black)
- **Weight:** 600 (Bold for the number)

#### VERTICAL DIVIDER:
- **Position:** X: ~520px (center of page)
- **Y Start:** 725px (aligned with QR/Logo top)
- **Y End:** 900px (above date area)
- **Style:** 1px solid `#e0e0e0` (Light gray)
- **Height:** ~175px

### LOGOS BOTTOM RIGHT:

**NHIC Logo (National Health Information Center):**
- **Position:** X: 750px, Y: 905px (bottom right area)
- **Size:** Width: **100px**, Height: **40px**
- **Contains:** 
  - Icon: Abstract human figure with DNA helix or health symbol (teal/blue-green color: `#00897b` or `#26a69a`)
  - Text: "مركز المعلومات الوطني الصحي" (Arabic, small, above)
  - Text: "NATIONAL HEALTH INFORMATION CENTER" (English, below, very small ~7-8px, uppercase)
- **Colors:** Teal/Cyan palette

**Note:** If CBAHI/LEAN logo exists (mentioned in prompt), it would be positioned at X: 650px, Y: 905px, size ~60x30px, but appears to be replaced by NHIC in this specific image version.

---

## 6. SPACING SPECIFICATIONS (Precise Gaps)

```
[Header End: Y=95px]
    ↓ Gap: 35px
[Title Start: Y=130px]
    ↓ Gap: 15px (between Arabic/English titles)
[Title End: Y=190px]
    ↓ Gap: 30px
[Table Start: Y=220px]
    ↓ Table Height: ~480px (11 rows × ~43px avg)
[Table End: Y=700px]
    ↓ Gap: 30px
[Footer Start: Y=730px]
    ↓ Footer Height: ~200px
[Page End: Y=950px+]
```

**Internal Table Spacing:**
- Cell padding: **12px 16px** (vertical horizontal)
- Row gap: 0 (collapsed borders)
- Label-value gap within cell: N/A (separate columns)

**Footer Internal Spacing:**
- QR to text: **15px**
- Arabic text to English text: **8px**
- English text to link: **8px**
- Link to date block: **35px**
- Logo to hospital name: **12px**
- Arabic hospital name to English: **6px**
- English to license: **8px**

---

## 7. COLOR PALETTE SUMMARY (Hex Codes)

| Element | Color Name | Hex Code |
|---------|-----------|----------|
| Primary Blue (Titles/Labels) | Royal Blue | `#1565c0` |
| Dark Navy (Duration Row) | Indigo 900 | `#1a237e` |
| Text Dark | Almost Black | `#212121` |
| Text Medium | Dark Gray | `#424242` |
| Text Light | Medium Gray | `#757575` |
| Background White | Pure White | `#FFFFFF` |
| Alternating Row BG | Cloud White | `#F5F7FA` or `#FAFAFA` |
| Borders | Mercury | `#E0E0E0` or `#CFD8DC` |
| Links | Blue | `#1976D2` |
| Header Text (Kingdom) | Black | `#000000` |
| Seha Logo Blue | Bright Blue | `#2E7DCE` |
| Geometric Pattern | Light Steel Blue | `#B8C9DB` |
| Hospital Name | Deep Blue | `#1A237E` |

---

## 8. TYPOGRAPHY DETAILS

**Font Families (Fallback Stack):**
- **Arabic:** `'Cairo', 'Tajawal', 'Dubai', 'Arial', sans-serif`
- **English:** `'Roboto', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', sans-serif`
- **Kingdom Emblem:** `'Traditional Arabic', 'Amiri', serif`

**Font Weights:**
- Labels: 600 (Semi-bold)
- Titles: 600-700 (Bold)
- Values: 400 (Regular)
- License numbers: 700 (Bold)

**Text Transforms:**
- English labels: Title Case ("Leave ID", "Admission Date")
- English values: As-is (mixed case for names, uppercase for IDs)
- Arabic: As-is (no transform)

---

## 9. SPECIAL VISUAL ELEMENTS TO NOTE

1. **RTL Support:** The document is visually symmetric but technically should support `dir="rtl"` for proper Arabic rendering, though the table structure shows English on left/center and Arabic on right/center.

2. **Zebra Striping:** Rows alternate between white (`#FFF`) and very light gray-blue (`#F5F7FA`), EXCEPT the dark blue duration row which breaks the pattern.

3. **Rounded Corners:** Only the outer table container has `border-radius: 8px`. Inner cells have square corners where they meet.

4. **Shadow:** Subtle box-shadow on table: `0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)` giving slight elevation.

5. **QR Code Styling:** Clean, no border, sharp corners (not rounded).

6. **Vertical Divider:** The footer divider line does not touch the top or bottom edges of the footer section (has 5px padding top/bottom).

7. **Geometric Pattern:** The top-right Islamic geometric shape is decorative only, positioned behind/in the header area with low opacity, not interfering with text readability.

This specification should allow pixel-perfect recreation using HTML/CSS with Flexbox/Grid for layout and standard table elements for the data section.
